items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Dr. Cavado hired me from seven to nine... I played that Mardi Gras parade.

ctx.x: I believe he went a year before or so.

I believe Tom Brown went up. Because, uh, we used to speak about these things, you know. And, uh, after that, he went up. Then, after that, my boy took each band up there, see? And, uh, that's how they come to be up north. You understand? In fact, I couldn't go. I really couldn't go because I had too much contract, too many contracts, you understand, to fill, see? And, uh, you can believe me or not. I was speaking to a man the other day. Well, you can say and stand up to say you played five jobs, six, five, and…
